scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w @stockledger/api" "npm run dev -w @stockledger/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stockledger/api && npm run build -w @stockledger/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stockledger/api && npm run typecheck -w @stockledger/web
